description.value: Aline Sports is an authorized Specialized dealer in Richmond, BC that bills itself as the only mountain bike specialist in the area, stocking a wide range from entry-level commuters to high-end S-Works models. The shop runs a dedicated repair department and carries an extensive parts, clothing, and accessories inventory across bike and snow disciplines. Touring cyclists will find a full-service shop environment with repair expertise, rentals, and a broad component selection.
